notes: Natural Earth 1:50m physical vectors, v4.0.0. Converted shapefile → GeoJSON with `npx mapshaper ne_50m_coastline.shp -clip bbox=-15,18,50,62 -simplify 15% keep-shapes -o format=geojson precision=0.001`, clipped to the Roman-extent bounding box (lon −15..50, lat 18..62). Attribution not required; "Made with Natural Earth" credited anyway.
Natural Earth 1:50m physical vectors, v4.0.0. Same mapshaper conversion as coastline.geojson.

Natural Earth 1:50m physical vectors, v5.0.0. Same mapshaper conversion as coastline.geojson; kept all 92 features in the clip extent rather than pre-filtering by scalerank, to avoid dropping historically relevant rivers (e.g. Rhône, Jordan) that carry a high scalerank in this dataset despite their historical importance.
Natural Earth 1:50m physical vectors, v5.0.0. Same mapshaper conversion as coastline.geojson.
